decisions.decision: The minutes of the June 8, 2017 meeting were accepted (no vote recorded).
decisions.quote: minutes of the june 8, 2017, meeting were accepted.

decisions.decision: The SWTF's review of the Stormwater Management Plan NOI with the Board of Selectmen will be held in October; Phyllis Luck will request it be put on the agenda.
decisions.quote: it was determined that it would fit best to have a review with the bos in october.

decisions.decision: Phyllis Luck will request that the BOS review be put on the agenda.
decisions.quote: phyllis will request that this be put on the agenda.

decisions.decision: Adam Burney agreed to create summaries of each MCM to facilitate the BOS presentation.
decisions.quote: adam has agreed to create summaries of each mcm to facilitate this presentation.

decisions.decision: Minor changes were made to the NOI draft, including replacing “Planning Department” with “Land Use Department”.
decisions.quote: a few minor changes were made, such as the replacement terminology of "land use department" for "planning department"

decisions.decision: Within MCM 6, the O&M responsible departments/entities will include Town Departments in addition to DPW Operations.
decisions.quote: would include town departments in addition to the dpw operations

decisions.decision: The BOS first wants the SWTF to focus on the “must do’s” with the available funds; low-hanging-fruit tasks will be undertaken if they are easy, good value, and move stormwater management forward.
decisions.quote: it was discussed that the bos first wants the swtf to focus on the "must do's" with the available funds.

decisions.decision: The SWTF will discuss the consultant hiring for the Community Compact scope of work at its next meeting on 8/24/17.
decisions.quote: the swtf will discuss at the next meeting to be held on 8/24/17.

decisions.decision: The third-quarter meeting schedule was confirmed as August 24, September 14, and 28; the October–December schedule will be discussed at the next meeting.
